y-m-60-03.topic: Uqikelelo lweelogarithm eziqhelekileyo nenani lamanani: singalithemba kude kangakanani uqikelelo?
y-m-60-03.goal: Funda ukuba impazamo encinci koqikelelo inokutshintsha isigqibo njengoko n iba nkulu, fumana iimeko apho isigqibo sahluka, uze uchaze iimeko apho uqikelelo lunokuthenjwa.
y-m-60-03.material: Sifuna ukufumana ukuba 2ⁿ inamanani amangaphi. Ixabiso lokwenyani le-log 2 li-0.30102999566…, kodwa uSoyoung wasebenzisa uqikelelo 0.301 waza wafumana inani lamanani ngokongeza u-1 kwinxalenye epheleleyo ye-n × 0.301. (Inxalenye epheleleyo linani eliphelele elingaphambi kwedesimali. Umzekelo: inxalenye epheleleyo ye-9.03 yi-9.)

y-m-60-05.title: Umjikelo ophindaphindayo womgangatho wolwandle: ingaba idatha isixelela kangakanani?
y-m-60-05.topic: Ixesha lokuphindaphinda lomsebenzi wesayini: lingagqitywa kangakanani ixesha lokuphindaphinda ngokusuka kulinganiso olwenziwe ngamaxesha alinganayo
y-m-60-05.goal: Funda ukuba idatha elinganiswe ngamaxesha amade ayinakugqiba ixesha lokuphindaphinda, hlengahlengisa umgwebo wakho njengoko idatha eninzi ifika, uze uthelekise iimodeli zabagqatswa ngqo nolinganiso.

y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Imodeli yokuqala ye-T=12 isondele ekubeni nyanisile kodwa ayichanekanga. Ulinganiso olubini emva kweeyure ezili-12 nemva kweeyure ezingama-24 luyachazeka xa i-T yahlukile kancinci kwi-12. Ukuba lithini ixabiso elililo liya kuthelekiswa ngokubala abagqatswa kwinyathelo elilandelayo.
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Gcina i-T=12. Cinga ukuba ulinganiso nje luguquguquke ngenxa yamaza
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: I-T=12 iqikelela u-3.0 kunye no-3.0, kodwa ulinganiso lungu-2.6 kunye no-2.2. Kukho iyantlukwano ezimbini ngaphaya kokuguquguquka kwe-±0.2 m, yaye zikwicala eliqhubeka lisanda.
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: I-T=12 ayichazi ulinganiso olubini. Bala abanye abagqatswa be-T uze ubathelekise
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kuba ixabiso ku-t=24 li-2.2, imodeli ekwimilo yesayini ngokwayo iyaphosakala
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Imilo ichanekile. Amaxabiso eeyure ezi-6 zokuqala alandele imilo yesayini kakuhle. Into efuna ukutshintsha lixabiso lexesha lokuphindaphinda T.
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.2.o.d: I-T mfutshane kuno-12. Ubude behle ngaphantsi kwe-3, ngoko iyaphinda ngokukhawuleza
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ukuba i-T imfutshane kuno-12, ngoko ngo-t=12 sele iwele umjikelo omnye opheleleyo yaye inokunika ixabiso eliphezulu kuno-3.0. Umzekelo, bala i-h(12) kunye ne-T=11.5.
y-m-60-05.s.s1.reflect: Kwakusiza njani ukuthatha iiyure ezili-12 njenge-'mgqatswa oxhomekeke' kunokuba 'uqinisekise' kwidatha yokuqala kwidatha yokugqibela? Kwelinye icala, ukuba ubuqinisekise iiyure ezili-12, yeyiphi idatha ebiya kuyishukumisa loo ngcamango?
y-m-60-05.s.s2.prompt: Ngowuphi kubagqatswa be-T ochaza zombini ulinganiso emva kweeyure ezili-12 nemva kweeyure ezingama-24 (t=12: 2.6 m, t=24: 2.2 m) ngaphakathi kwe-±0.2 m? Bala i-h(12) kunye ne-h(24) kumgqatswa ngamnye uze uthelekise.
y-m-60-05.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha umgqatswa omnye, faka t=12 kwifomyula, fumana i-h(12) ngekhalkyuleyitha kwimowudi yeeradiyan, uze uyithelekise nolinganiso.
y-m-60-05.s.s2.hint.1: Yenza ukubala okufanayo ku-t=24, uze ufumane umgqatswa apho onke amaxabiso omabini ali ngaphakathi kwe-±0.2 m.
y-m-60-05.s.s2.r.a: h(12)≈3.54 kunye ne-h(24)≈4.04. Phezulu kakhulu kunamaxabiso alinganisiweyo.
y-m-60-05.s.s2.r.b: h(12)=3.0 kunye ne-h(24)=3.0. Ziyahluka kulinganiso lwe-2.6 nelwe-2.2 nge-0.4 nange-0.8.
y-m-60-05.s.s2.r.d: h(12)≈2.07 kunye ne-h(24)≈1.35. Zingaphantsi kakhulu kunamaxabiso alinganisiweyo.
y-m-60-05.s.s2.explain: Ukuba T=12.4, ke h(12)≈2.60 kunye ne-h(24)≈2.21, ezihambelana nolinganiso olubini. I-T=12 inika u-3.0 kunye no-3.0, i-T=13 inika u-2.07 kunye no-1.35, yaye i-T=11.5 inika u-3.54 kunye no-4.04, ngoko azinakuchaza zombini ulinganiso ngaxeshanye. (Kwiindawo ezifana nesi sibuko, apho amanzi enyuka ehla kabini ngemini, ixesha lokuphindaphinda ngokwenene lide kancinci kuneeyure ezili-12.)

y-m-60-04.title: Ukuba i-sin θ ngu-3/5, ngaba i-cos θ imiselwe ngokuyodwa?
y-m-60-04.topic: Ubudlelwane phakathi kwemisebenzi ye-trigonometri: imiqathango apho i-cos θ ne-tan θ zimiselwa xa i-sin θ inikiwe
y-m-60-04.goal: Bonisa, ngokufumana onke amaxabiso anokwenzeka, ukuba ixabiso lesayini lodwa alimiseli amaxabiso ekhosayini nethanjenti ngokuyodwa, uze ukhethe ulwazi oluyongezelelweyo olumisela amaxabiso.
y-m-60-04.material: I-engile θ yi-engile eqhelekileyo (akunamsebenzi nokuba kuyiradiyan okanye kuyidigri) yaye i-sin θ = 3/5. UHarin wathi, "Kuba i-sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, i-cos θ = 4/5 kwaye i-tan θ = 3/4." (Indlela yokufunda: i-sin θ yi-'sayini theta', i-sin²θ yi-'sayini theta esikwere', yaye i-3/5 yi-'ezintathu kwezintlanu'.)
y-m-60-04.prereq.0: Inkcazo yemisebenzi ye-trigonometri kwii-engile eziqhelekileyo kunye nemiqondiso yazo kwikhwadranti nganye
y-m-60-04.prereq.2: Esi sisinqanaba sobunzima salo msebenzi (H3), hayi umsebenzi webanga lesikolo, yaye sicinga ukuba ugqibile icandelo lemisebenzi ye-trigonometri.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.prompt: Ngowuphi owona mgwebo ufanelekileyo ngesiphelo sikaHarin?
y-m-60-04.s.s1.hint.0: Fumana ixabiso le-cos²θ, uze ubale ukuba mangaphi amanani analo ixabiso xa enziwa isikwere.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala ukuba ngawaphi amakhwadranti aqulethe ii-engile apho i-sin θ ilungile.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.o.a: Kuchanekile. Ukusuka ku-sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, i-cos θ = 4/5 kwaye i-tan θ = 3/4 ziyamiselwa
y-m-60-04.s.s1.r.a: Hlola ukuba linye kuphela inani esikwere salo si-16/25 na.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.o.b: I-cos θ iphuma njengamaxabiso amabini, 4/5 kunye no-−4/5, kodwa umgaqo kukuthatha ingcambu yesikwere elungileyo, ngoko imiselwe ukuba ibe yi-4/5
y-m-60-04.s.s1.r.b: Umgaqo wokuthatha ingcambu elungileyo ngophawu lwengcambu yesikwere. Hlola ukuba i-engile apho i-cos θ inegatifu inokwanelisa i-sin θ = 3/5 na.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.o.c: I-cos θ inokuba yi-4/5 okanye −4/5, ngoko ayimiselwanga ukuba ibe lixabiso elinye ngolwazi olunikiweyo lodwa
y-m-60-04.s.s1.o.d: Ukuba i-sin θ = 3/5, ke i-θ kufuneka ibe yi-engile kwikhwadranti yokuqala, ngoko ixabiso likaHarin lichanekile
y-m-60-04.s.s1.r.d: Hlola ukuba ii-engile ezine-sin θ elungileyo zikho kuphela kwikhwadranti yokuqala na.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.explain: Kuba i-sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, cos²θ = 1 − 9/25 = 16/25, ngoko cos θ = 4/5 okanye −4/5. Ukuba i-sin θ>0, i-θ ikwikhwadranti yokuqala okanye yesibini, ngoko zozibini iimeko ziyakwazeka.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.prompt: Fumana uze ufake iibini ezimbini ezahlukeneyo zamaxabiso (cos θ, tan θ) ezinokwenzeka kwi-engile θ ene-sin θ = 3/5. (Bhala amaqhezu njengeedesimali. Umzekelo: 3/5 = 0.6)
y-m-60-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ufumane i-cos²θ, uze ufumane onke amaxabiso e-cos θ ayinikayo.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kwi-cos θ nganye, bala i-sin θ ÷ cos θ ukuze ufumane i-tan θ.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Ayiyo i-sin²θ + cos²θ = 1. I-sin²θ ngu-0.36. Hlola ukuba isikwere se-cos θ kufuneka sibe yintoni.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Iyanelisa i-tan θ = sin θ ÷ cos θ.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.fail.c2: I-tan θ × cos θ ayilingani ne-sin θ = 0.6. Fumana i-tan θ kwakhona.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.explain: Ukuba i-cos θ = 0.8, ke i-tan θ = 0.6 ÷ 0.8 = 0.75, yaye ukuba i-cos θ = −0.8, ke i-tan θ = −0.75. Ezi zimbini zizo zonke izinto ezinokwenzeka.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.prompt: Sifuna ukucela ulwazi oluyongezelelweyo ukuze sikhethe phakathi kwezinto ezimbini ezinokwenzeka. Khetha zonke iingceba zolwazi ezingezantsi, ezi, ezongezwe kwi-sin θ = 3/5, ziya kumisela (cos θ, tan θ) ngokuyodwa nokuba kunikwe enye kuphela.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.hint.0: Faka abagqatswa ababini (0.8, 0.75) kunye (−0.8, −0.75) kwimeko yokhetho ngalunye.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.hint.1: Hlula ukhetho olwanelisa bobabini abagqatswa kwezo zanelisa omnye kuphela.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.r.b: Phakathi kuka-0 no-π kukho ii-engile kuzo zombini ikhwadranti yokuqala neyesibini. Jonga ukuba bobabini abagqatswa bayasala na.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.o.c: Inyaniso yokuba i-cos θ + sin θ < 1
y-m-60-04.s.s3.o.d: Inyaniso yokuba i-θ yi-engile ekwikhwadranti yokuqala okanye yesibini
y-m-60-04.s.s3.r.d: Ukuba i-sin θ>0, oku sele kuyaziwa. Hlola ukuba ulwazi olutsha na.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.r.e: Kubo bobabini abagqatswa, i-cos θ ayiyo u-0. Hlola ukuba iyakwazi ukubahlula na.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.o.f: Inyaniso yokuba i-sin θ × cos θ > 0
y-m-60-04.s.s3.explain: Abagqatswa ngu-(0.8, 0.75) kunye no-(−0.8, −0.75). a: i-tan θ<0 yanelisa yesibini kuphela. c: i-cos θ + sin θ ngu-1.4 kowokuqala no-−0.2 kowesibini, ngoko <1 yanelisa yesibini kuphela. f: i-sin θ × cos θ>0 ithetha i-cos θ>0, ngoko yowokuqala kuphela oyanelisayo. b, d, kunye ne-e zanelisa bobabini abagqatswa, ngoko azinakubahlula.

y-m-60-02.title: Ingaba isixhobo esikhulu sihlala siliyixabiso elikhulu?
y-m-60-02.topic: Ukuthelekisa izixhobo: iimeko apho icala lokungalingani lixhomekeke kwisiseko
y-m-60-02.goal: Funda ukuba 'yonke imizekelo endiyihloleyo iyasebenza' ayonelanga njengobungqina bebango elibanzi, yakha umzekelo ochasayo wena, uze ukhethe iimeko ezifunekayo ukufikelela esigqibeni.
y-m-60-02.material: UMinji wathi, "a ingqina kwaye a≠1. Ngoko ukuba aᵐ < aⁿ, ngoko m < n." (m no-n ngamanani aqinisileyo. Indlela yokufunda: aᵐ 'a kumandla e-m'.) UMinji wahlola ukuba nge-a=2, 2¹ < 2³, yaye nge-a=3, 3² < 3⁵, yaye kuzo zombini m<n.
y-m-60-02.thinking.0: Gweba ukuba imizekelo imele kangakanani (loluphi uluhlu lweziseko olwavavanywa)
y-m-60-02.prereq.0: Amandla neemithetho zamandla (kubandakanya izixhobo ezibi nezero)
y-m-60-02.prereq.2: Eli linqanaba lobunzima lalo msebenzi (H3), hayi isabelo senyaka wesikolo, yaye lithatha ukuba sele ugqibile icandelo lamandla neelogarithm.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.prompt: Ngokusekelwe kwimizekelo emibini ehlolwe nguMinji, yeyiphi eyona ntetho ifanelekileyo ngebango likaMinji?
y-m-60-02.s.s1.hint.0: Jonga apho kuluhlu olunokwenzeka luka-a amaxabiso avavanywe nguMinji aqokelelene khona.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha a enye kuluhlu olungavavanywanga uze ubale ngokwenene aᵐ no-aⁿ.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.o.a: Isebenze kabini, nge-2 nange-3, ngoko sinokuthi ibango lisebenza kuyo yonke a
y-m-60-02.s.s1.r.a: Ukusebenza kabini akubungqina. Qala ujonge ukuba amanani eziseko ezivavanyiweyo asuka kuluhlu luni.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.o.b: Asinakuqiniseka ide sivavanye ngokwahlukileyo iimeko apho m no-n ngamanani aqinisileyo angengawo aphelele
y-m-60-02.s.s1.r.b: Ingxaki kuluhlu lweseko a kunoluhlu lwe-m ne-n. Jonga kwakhona amaxabiso ka-a avavanyiweyo.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.o.c: Iziseko ezivavanyiweyo zonke zikhulu kuno-1, ngoko sinokuqiniseka emva kokuvavanya iziseko ezincinci kuno-1 kwakhona
y-m-60-02.s.s1.o.d: Imizekelo esebenzayo ayiliphuli ibango, ngoko ukuba akukho mzekelo ochasayo ovelayo, singalamkela njengelinyani
y-m-60-02.s.s1.r.d: Ukungazange ufune umzekelo ochasayo kwahlukile ekungabikho komzekelo ochasayo. Bona ukuba ngawaphi amaxabiso ka-a angakavavanywa.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.explain: Iziseko ezivavanyiweyo 2 no-3 zombini zikhulu kuno-1. Ekubeni a ingaba ngu-0<a<1 nayo, asinakuthi 'ngalo lonke ixesha' side sivavanye loo meko. Uluhlu olumelwa yimizekelo ehloliweyo lumisela ukomelela kobungqina.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza ufake ezi-2 (a, m, n) ezineziseko a ezahlukeneyo ukuze aᵐ < aⁿ kodwa m>n. (a linani elikhulu kuno-0 elingalingani no-1. Unokulibhala njengedesimali.)
y-m-60-02.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha a ibe linani elincinci kuno-1, uze ubale amaxabiso ambalwa ukubona ukuba aᵐ itshintsha njani njengoko m iba nkulu.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha amanani aphelele ambalwa e-m ne-n, bala a^m no-a^n, uze uthelekise ubukhulu bazo.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.ok.c1: a likhulu kuno-0 kwaye alingalingani no-1.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.fail.c1: a kufuneka ingqine kwaye ingalingani no-1.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.fail.c2: m alikhulu kuno-n. Khetha amanani amabini ane-m>n.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.fail.c3: aᵐ ayincinci kuno-aⁿ. Bala ngokwenene amaxabiso omabini uze uwathelekise.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo, nge-a=0.5, m=3, n=1, sifumana 0.5³=0.125 < 0.5¹=0.5 nangona m>n. Nge-a=0.25, m=2, n=−1, sifumana 0.0625 < 4. Ibango likaMinji alisebenzi kwi-0<a<1.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.prompt: Ukusuka kwinyaniso yokuba aᵐ < aⁿ, yintoni enye ekufuneka uyazi, ukongeza kwimeko engentla (a ingqina, a≠1), ukuze ugqibe m < n? Khetha zonke ezanelisayo. (Ungafumanisa ngokwakha imizekelo echasayo uvavanye.)
y-m-60-02.s.s3.hint.0: Kukhetho ngalunye, khangela i-(a, m, n) eyanelisa imeko yalo kodwa isengumzekelo ochasayo.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.hint.1: Kukhetho ngalunye, hlola ukuba uluhlu olusalayo luka-a luqulethe amanani amancinci kuno-1.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.r.a: Ukuba a linani lemvelo kwaye alingalingani no-1, cinga ukuba a iqala phi. Bhala elona xabiso lincinci elinokwenzeka.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.o.b: Inyaniso yokuba m no-n zombini zingqina
y-m-60-02.s.s3.r.b: a=0.5, m=3, n=1 ine-m no-n zombini zingqina, kodwa aᵐ<aⁿ ngelixa m>n.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.r.c: Nge-a=0.7, m=3, n=1, sifumana 0.343<0.7 nangona m>n.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.r.d: Ukuba a likhulu kuno-1, aˣ itshintsha kuphela kwicala lokunyuka, ngoko icala lokungalingani lihlala linjalo.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.r.e: Yimeko esele siyaziwa, ngoko asilulwazi olutsha. Ayiwahluli u-a>1 no-0<a<1.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.explain: Ukuba a>1, aˣ iyanda, ngoko aᵐ<aⁿ ⇒ m<n. Ukuba a linani lemvelo elingelo-1, ngoko a≥2, ngoko a>1, nalo liyanelisa. Kwi-b, c, no-e, amaxabiso ka-a ane-0<a<1 asala, ngoko umzekelo ochasayo unokwenzeka. Ngendlela, ukuba 0<a<1 ibisaziwa, isigqibo bekuya kuba nguye m>n endaweni.

y-m-60-01.title: Isisombululo esinye kuphela? Umsebenzi waphosakala phi?
y-m-60-01.topic: Iipropati zelogarithm nemeko yengxoxo: izisombululo ze-log₂(x²)=4
y-m-60-01.goal: Funda ukuba inyathelo elisebenzisa ipropati yelogarithm lingatshintsha uluhlu oluvumelekileyo lwe-x, fumana umgca apho izisombululo zinyamalala uze ulungise, uze ukhethe amanyathelo angatshintshi luhlu.
y-m-60-01.material: USuho wasombulula ulingano log₂(x²) = 4 (x linani leqinisileyo elingengo-0) njengoko kubonisiwe ngezantsi. (Indlela yokufunda: log₂ A 'yilogarithm ka-A enesiseko 2', yaye x² 'x isikwere'.)
y-m-60-01.thinking.0: Hlola ukuba umgca ngamnye uyasebenza phantsi kweemeko ezifanayo nomgca ongaphambi kwawo
y-m-60-01.thinking.2: Thelekisa uluhlu oluvumelekileyo phambi nasemva kotshintsho
y-m-60-01.prereq.0: Inkcazo neepropati zeelogarithm (ingxoxo kufuneka ingqine, yaye log M^k = k·log M isetyenziswa xa M>0)
y-m-60-01.prereq.1: Ubudlelwane phakathi kwamanani anexabiso eliphelele nesikwere esifanayo
y-m-60-01.prereq.2: Eli linqanaba lobunzima lalo msebenzi (H3), hayi isabelo senyaka wesikolo, yaye lithatha ukuba sele ufundile iipropati zamandla neelogarithm.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca omnye kwisisombululo sikaSuho apho siphosakala khona.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.hint.0: Thelekisa ukuba umgca ngamnye uyasebenza kuluhlu olufanayo lwe-x njengomgca ongaphambi kwawo.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.hint.1: Faka x enye ebi kulingano lokuqala uze uhlole ukuba ixabiso lichaziwe na.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.explain: Umgca wesi-2 yiyo apho iphosakala khona. log₂ x ingasetyenziswa kuphela xa x ingqina, kodwa ulingano lokuqala lunentsingiselo nakwi-x ebi, kuba x² ingqina. Umgca wesi-2 ushiya imeko x<0, yaye ngenxa yoko, ibango elithi 'esinye kuphela' kumgca wesi-5 sisigqibo esingalunganga. Umgca wesi-5 wamkelwa njengomgca ongalunganga nawo. Nakwi-x = −4 log₂ 16 = 4.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.prompt: Fumana ufake amanani aqinisileyo amabini ahlukeneyo x anelisa ulingano lokuqala log₂(x²) = 4.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.hint.0: Usebenzisa inkcazo yelogarithm, bhala kwakhona log₂ A = 4 njengobudlelwane phakathi kuka-A no-2.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.hint.1: Faka x oyifumeneyo kwi-log₂(x²) yokuqala uze uhlole ukuba ufumana u-4.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Ukuba x=0, ngoko x²=0, ngoko ingxoxo yelogarithm ayingqina.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Ixabiso le-log₂(x²) asingu-4. Cinga kwakhona ukuba loluphi amandla ka-2 anika x².
y-m-60-01.s.s2.explain: Ngenkcazo yelogarithm, x² = 2⁴ = 16, ngoko x = 4 okanye x = −4. Onke amaxabiso omabini anelisa ulingano lokuqala, ngoko zikho izisombululo ezimbini.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.prompt: Utshintsho olufana nomgca wesi-2 kaSuho lunokutshintsha uluhlu oluvumelekileyo lwe-x. Khetha zonke iinguqu ezingezantsi apho 'uluhlu lwamaxabiso anokuthathwa ngu-x lufana phambi nasemva'. (x linani leqinisileyo.)
y-m-60-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kwicala lasekhohlo nelasekunene lokhetho ngalunye, bhala ngokwahlukileyo 'x kufuneka ibe kuluhlu luni ukuze ixabiso elingaphakathi kwelogarithm lingqina', uze uzithelekise.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kukhetho apho uluhlu lubonakala luhlukile, faka x enye ebi kumacala omabini.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.r.a: Icala lasekunene linentsingiselo kuphela xa x>0, ngelixa icala lasekhohlo lidinga x≠0 kuphela. Faka x=−4 kumacala omabini.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.r.b: Thelekisa ukuba imeko yokuba x/3 ingqine ifana nemeko yokuba x ingqine.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.r.c: Icala lasekhohlo linentsingiselo nakwi-x<0 okanye x>2. Cinga ukuba icala lasekunene linentsingiselo kuluphi uluhlu.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.r.d: Icala lasekhohlo linentsingiselo kuphela kwi-x>0, ngelixa icala lasekunene linentsingiselo nokuba x ibi. Uluhlu lwabanzi.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.r.e: Imeko yokuba |x| ingqine ifana ne-x≠0. Hlola ukuba i-x ebi ibandakanyiwe.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.explain: Kwi-b, x/3>0 ⇔ x>0, ngoko uluhlu lufanayo, yaye kwi-e, |x|>0 ⇔ x≠0, ngoko uluhlu lufanayo. Kwi-a, x<0 inyamalala; kwi-c, icala le-x<0 linyamalala; yaye kwi-d, uluhlu lwabanza ngolunye uhlobo. Utshintsho olutshintsha uluhlu lunokukwenza ulahlekelwe okanye ufumane izisombululo, ngoko emva kokutshintsha kufuneka ufake kwakhona kulingano lokuqala ukuhlola.

y-m-60-07.title: Ukuhlola isisombululo sifumana ilungu elilinganayo kwifomyula yesixa
y-m-60-07.topic: Isixa solandelelwano nelungu laso elilinganayo: ukuhlola ilungu lokuqala xa kufunyanwa i-aₙ kwi-Sₙ
y-m-60-07.goal: Kwisisombululo sifumana ilungu elilinganayo kwisixa Sₙ, fumana apho ingcamango ye-n≥2 ilahlekileyo, hlola ngamanani achanekileyo, uze wakhe ngokwakho ifomyula yesixa apho ilungu lokuqala lingafuni ukumiselwa ngokwahlukileyo.
y-m-60-07.material: Kulandelelwano {aₙ}, isixa selungu lokuqala ukuya kwelungu le-n yi-Sₙ = n² + 2n + 3 (n linani lemvelo), yaye uEunwoo wafumana ilungu elilinganayo njengoko kubonisiwe ngezantsi. (Indlela yokufunda: aₙ yi-'ilungu le-n', Sₙ yi-'isixa ukusuka kwilungu lokuqala ukuya kwilungu le-n', yaye Sₙ₋₁ yi-'isixa ukuya kwilungu le-(n−1)'.)
y-m-60-07.prereq.0: Ubudlelwane phakathi kwesixa Sₙ nelungu elilinganayo aₙ lolandelelwano (Sₙ sisixa ukusuka kwilungu lokuqala ukuya kwilungu le-n)
y-m-60-07.prereq.2: Esi sisinqanaba sobunzima salo msebenzi (H3), hayi umsebenzi webanga lesikolo, yaye sicinga ukuba ugqibile icandelo lolandelelwano.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca omnye kwisisombululo sikaEunwoo apho kuphosakala khona.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.hint.0: Thelekisa isiphelo a₁ = 3 ngqo nenkcazo ye-S₁ (isixa ukusuka kwilungu lokuqala ukuya kwilungu lokuqala).
y-m-60-07.s.s1.hint.1: Jonga ukuba i-Sₙ₋₁ iba yintoni xa ufaka n=1 kwifomyula emgceni 1.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.line.3: Ngoko kwinani ngalinye lemvelo n, aₙ = 2n + 1.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.explain: Umgca 1 usebenza kuphela xa n≥2. I-S₀ ayichazwanga, ngoko ayinakusetyenziswa kwi-n=1. Ngoko 'ilinani ngalinye lemvelo n' emgceni 4 kunye no-a₁ = 3 emgceni 5 ziyaphosakala. Ilungu lokuqala yi-a₁ = S₁ = 1 + 2 + 3 = 6. Ukubala emigceni 2 nesi-3 (2n+1 xa n≥2) kuchanekile. Ukukhetha nawuphi na umgca 1, umgca 4, okanye umgca 5 kuyamkelwa.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.prompt: Sₙ = pn² + qn + r (p, q, r ziinani eziphelele, p≥1), S₃ = 21, yaye ilungu lokuqala a₁ = S₁ lingaphezulu okanye lilingane no-1. Kule meko, fumana amaxabiso amabini ahlukeneyo e-p apho ixabiso elifunyenwe ngokufaka n=1 kwifomyula esuka ku-aₙ = Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ (xa n≥2) lilingana ne-S₁ (oko kukuthi, iimeko apho ilungu lokuqala lingafuni ukumiselwa ngokwahlukileyo), uze uwafake.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.hint.0: Bala i-Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ ngqo kwi-pn² + qn + r uze uyenze lula ibe yintetho ye-n.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.hint.1: Fumana imeko eyenza ixabiso lentetho leyo ku-n=1 lilingane ne-S₁ = p + q + r.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.ok.c1: I-p, q, r ziinani eziphelele yaye p≥1.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.fail.c1: I-p, q, r kufuneka zibe ziinani eziphelele, yaye i-p kufuneka ibe ubuncinane ngu-1.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Ilungu lokuqala S₁ lingaphezulu okanye lilingane no-1.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.fail.c3: S₁ = p + q + r incinci kuno-1.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.ok.c4: Ixabiso lefomyula ye-n≥2 ku-n=1 lilingana ne-S₁.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.fail.c4: Ukufaka n=1 kwifomyula 2pn + (q−p) efunyenwe kwi-n≥2 kunika p+q. Hlola ukuba i-r kufuneka ibe lixabiso elithini ukuze oku kulingane ne-S₁ = p+q+r.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.explain: Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ = 2pn + (q − p), yaye ukufaka n=1 kunika p + q. Ukuze oku kulingane ne-S₁ = p + q + r, kufuneka r = 0. Ke S₃ = 9p + 3q = 21, oko kukuthi, 3p + q = 7, yaye iibini zeenani eziphelele ezanelisa S₁ ≥ 1 zingu-(p, q) = (1, 4), (2, 1), (3, −2). Umzekelo, ukuba Sₙ = 3n² − 2n, ke aₙ = 6n − 5 isebenza noku-n=1 (a₁ = 1).
y-m-60-07.s.s3.prompt: Ngesivakalisi esinye okanye ezibini, usebenzisa ubuncinane ixabiso elinye elithile (inani), bhala isizathu sokuba kuphosakele ukusebenzisa i-aₙ = 2n + 1 kuyo yonke i-n kwi-Sₙ = n² + 2n + 3 kaEunwoo.
y-m-60-07.s.s3.hint.0: Jonga ukuba i-Sₙ₋₁ yintoni xa n=1 kwi-aₙ = Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ kaEunwoo.
y-m-60-07.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ecaleni kwelinye ixabiso le-S₁ elibaliswe ngqo kunye nexabiso le-2n+1 ku-n=1.
y-m-60-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba usebenzise inyaniso yokuba i-a₁ ilingana ne-S₁ ukufumana u-6?
y-m-60-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ubonise ukungahambelani ngokuthelekisa nexabiso le-2n+1 ku-n=1?
y-m-60-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uthe nale fomyula inokusetyenziswa kuphela kwi-n≥2?
y-m-60-07.s.s3.model.0: I-a₁ yi-S₁, ngoko ngu-1 + 2 + 3 = 6, kodwa ukufaka n=1 kwi-2n + 1 kunika u-3, ngoko ziyahluka. Ngoko le fomyula inokusetyenziswa kuphela kwi-n≥2, yaye ilungu lokuqala kufuneka lifunyanwe ngokwahlukileyo.
y-m-60-07.s.s3.model.1: Ilungu lokuqala yi-S₁ = 6. Kodwa ukufaka n=1 kwi-aₙ = 2n+1 kunika u-3, ngoko iyaphosakala. Ukusebenzisa i-Sₙ₋₁, i-n kufuneka ibe ubuncinane ngu-2, ngoko n=1 kufuneka ihlolwe ngokwahlukileyo.
